title: PagedContractResponse
description: A single page of Contracts, matching either offset-based or cursor-based pagination.

data.description: Contracts on this page, in the order determined by the pagination mode used.

links.description: Navigation URLs for this result set. `next`/`prev` are `null` when there is no further page in that direction.

totalCount.description: Total number of contracts matching the request, across all pages.

Contract.description: A contract between a healthcare provider and a payer.

id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier (UUID). Ignored if supplied in a create request; on replace (PUT), the existing contract's id is always preserved regardless of what is sent.

planId.description: Identifier of the plan this contract belongs to. Required on create. On replace (PUT), any value supplied here is ignored - the existing contract's planId is always preserved.

networkId.description: Identifier of the network this contract belongs to. Required on create. On replace (PUT), any value supplied here is ignored - the existing contract's networkId is always preserved.

documentId.description: Caller-supplied business document identifier for this contract. Required on create. On replace (PUT), any value supplied here is ignored - the existing contract's documentId is always preserved.

createdBy.description: User ID of the caller who originally created the contract. Always set by the server from the authenticated caller on create; any value supplied in the request body is ignored. Preserved unchanged on every subsequent replace (PUT), regardless of the request body.

updatedBy.description: User ID of the caller who most recently created or replaced the contract. Always set by the server from the authenticated caller; any value supplied in the request body is ignored.

generalInfo.description: Core contract identity and classification fields. The section itself is not strictly required, but if supplied, its `contractId`/`contractName`/`contractType`/`contractStatus` fields are required.

lifecycle.description: Contract lifecycle dates (effective, term, termination, billing). Optional.

financial.description: Contract financial and payment terms. Optional.

administrativeAndLegal.description: Contract administrative and legal terms (notice periods, filing limits). Optional.

clinicalAndQuality.description: Contract clinical and quality program terms. Optional.

ContractAdministrativeAndLegalInfo.description: Contract administrative and legal terms. All fields are optional.

amendmentOnFile.description: Whether a signed amendment to this contract is on file.

amendmentNumber.description: Identifier/number of the amendment on file, if any.

practitionersTerminationNoticePeriod.description: Notice period, in days, a practitioner must give before terminating this contract.

providersManualUpdatesNoticePeriod.description: Notice period, in days, the payer must give providers before manual updates take effect.

policyUpdateNotificationRequired.description: Whether providers must be notified before a policy update takes effect.

claimFilingLimit.description: Deadline for submitting claims after the date of service.

reimbursementScheduleUpdateFrequency.description: How often the reimbursement schedule is updated.

timelyPaymentCommitment.description: Number of days within which the payer commits to paying a clean claim.

ContractClinicalAndQualityInfo.description: Contract clinical and quality program terms. All fields are optional.

hasQualityProgram.description: Whether this contract includes a quality incentive program.

qualityProgramInitiatives.description: Free-text description of the quality program's initiatives.

averageStarsAndPmpmBonus.description: Free-text summary of the star rating and per-member-per-month (PMPM) bonus tied to it.

hasMlrTarget.description: Whether this contract includes a medical loss ratio (MLR) target.

mlrTargetDescription.description: Free-text description of the medical loss ratio (MLR) target, if any.

performanceReportingRequirements.description: Description of the performance reporting the provider must submit under this contract.

credentialingDelegation.description: Whether credentialing responsibilities are delegated to the provider organization.

recredentialingInterval.description: How often practitioners under this contract must be recredentialed.

referralRequirements.description: Whether this contract imposes referral requirements (e.g. requires PCP referral).

priorAuthorizationRequired.description: Whether prior authorization is required for services under this contract.

panelSizeLimits.description: Free-text description of any panel size limits imposed on providers.

providerRosterUpdateFrequency.description: How often the provider roster must be updated under this contract.

ContractFinancialInfo.description: Contract financial and payment terms. All fields are optional.

feeSchedule.description: Name of the fee schedule used for standard reimbursement.

additionalFeeSchedule.description: Name of a supplemental fee schedule applied alongside the primary one, if any.

contractPaymentType.description: How the provider is paid under this contract.

nonTypicalContractTerms.description: Free-text description of any non-standard financial terms in this contract.

providerRateCalculation.description: Description of how the provider's reimbursement rate is calculated.

rateLesserOfClaimAllowed.description: Whether the contract allows paying the lesser of the billed charge or the contracted rate.

sequestrationAllowed.description: Whether Medicare sequestration reductions apply to payments under this contract.

sharedSavings.description: Whether this contract includes a shared-savings arrangement.

bonus.description: Whether this contract includes a performance bonus arrangement.

claimSubmissionCycle.description: How often claims must be submitted under this contract.

snfCorporateChampionRate.description: SNF corporate champion capitation rate, in dollars.

snfCapitationPartARate.description: SNF Medicare Part A capitation rate, in dollars.

snfCapitationPartBRate.description: SNF Medicare Part B capitation rate, in dollars.

snfCapitationBillAboveRate.description: Per-diem rate billed above the SNF capitation threshold, in dollars.

hasGssRate.description: Whether this contract includes a gain-share/shared-savings (GSS) rate.

gssRateDetails.description: Free-text details of the gain-share/shared-savings (GSS) rate arrangement.

gssMinimumMM.description: Minimum member-months (MM) required for the GSS rate to apply.

gssTerm.description: Free-text description of the GSS rate's contract term.

gssFrequency.description: How often the GSS rate is calculated and settled.

appPenalty.description: Description of any penalty applied for missed appointment (no-show) policies.

telehealthNoShow.description: Description of the telehealth no-show policy for this contract.

ContractGeneralInfo.description: Core contract identity and classification fields.

contractId.description: Business contract identifier assigned by the caller. Distinct from the top-level server-assigned `Contract.id`. Required.

contractName.description: Human-readable name of the contract. Required.

contractTemplate.description: Name of the contract template this agreement was drafted from.

contractRate.description: Free-text description of the contracted rate.

reimbursementCode.description: Reimbursement code associated with this contract.

contractType.description: Type of contract arrangement. Required. `FFS` = fee-for-service (paid per rendered service); `Capitation` = fixed per-member payment regardless of services rendered; `VBC` = value-based care (payment tied to outcomes/quality rather than volume).

vbcAttribution.description: Description of value-based-care attribution methodology, if applicable.

contractStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract. Required. `Active` = currently in effect; `Terminated` = ended; `Contracting` = under negotiation, not yet effective; `Not Known` = status could not be determined at the time of entry.

contractAgreementType.description: Structure of the contracting arrangement. Optional. `Single` = one provider entity; `Multiple Provider` = a named group of provider entities; `IPA` = Independent Practice Association (a legal entity of independent providers contracting collectively); `System` = a health system encompassing multiple facilities/providers.

groupId.description: Identifier of the group this contract applies to, if any.

practitionerId.description: Identifier of the individual practitioner this contract applies to, if any.

networkId.description: Identifier of the network this contract belongs to, mirroring the top-level `Contract.networkId`.

planId.description: Identifier of the plan this contract belongs to, mirroring the top-level `Contract.planId`.

ContractLifeCycleInfo.description: Contract lifecycle dates. All fields are optional and use the ISO-8601 `date` format (YYYY-MM-DD, no time or offset).

contractEffectiveDate.description: Date the contract terms take effect.

initialTermDate.description: Date the contract's initial term ends (subject to renewal).

terminationInformedDate.description: Date on which notice of termination was given.

billingEffectiveDate.description: Date from which billing under this contract is effective.

billingTerminationDate.description: Date after which billing under this contract stops.
